name: Continue & Claude Code Bundle
description: A curated collection of high-value developer commands and workflows for Continue.dev and Claude Code.

prompts.name: Unit Test Generator
prompts.content:
{{{ input }}}

Write a comprehensive set of unit tests for the selected code. It should setup, run tests that check for correctness including important edge cases, and teardown.

prompts.name: Doxygen Documentation Generator
prompts.content:
{{{ input }}}

Please write documentation for the function, following each of these instructions:
- use doxygen standard
- this is a c++ code

prompts.name: Code Refactor
prompts.content:
{{{ input }}}

Refactor the code above to make it cleaner, more readable, and efficient, while preserving all existing functional behavior and public API interfaces.

prompts.name: Conventional Commit Generator
prompts.content: @diff Generate a concise and descriptive Conventional Commit message (e.g., feat:, fix:, refactor:, docs:) summarizing the changes shown above. Include a short title and a bulleted body if significant changes were made.

prompts.name: Code Explainer
prompts.content:
{{{ input }}}

Please read the selected code carefully and explain step-by-step how it works. Highlight key inputs/outputs, algorithmic complexity, and any potential edge cases or bottlenecks.

prompts.name: Expert Code Reviewer
prompts.content: You are an expert Code Reviewer subagent. Analyze the target codebase/files for: 1. Security vulnerabilities (e.g., injection, auth flaws, unintended data exposure). 2. Performance bottlenecks, memory leaks, and inefficient operations. 3. Code style, maintainability, and adherence to established project patterns. 4. Missing edge-case handling, error handling, or validation logic. Provide structured, actionable feedback categorized by severity level (Critical, High, Medium, Low) with concrete fix suggestions.

prompts.name: Bug & Root Cause Debugger
prompts.content: You are a Debugger subagent. Given an error log, stack trace, or failing test suite: 1. Locate the exact source files and lines causing the issue. 2. Explain the fundamental root cause of the failure in clear detail. 3. Formulate a step-by-step resolution plan. 4. Provide a unified diff or exact code modification required to resolve the bug cleanly.

prompts.name: Automated Test Suite Generator
prompts.content: You are a Test Engineering subagent. Examine the specified source file and: 1. Identify all primary functions, exported interfaces, edge cases, and failure modes. 2. Inspect existing test files in the codebase to match the existing framework (e.g. pytest, Jest, Vitest) and naming conventions. 3. Write complete, runnable unit tests covering happy paths, boundary conditions, and expected exception handling.
